tldr: An estimated 60,000 migrants reached Spain's Ceuta from Morocco, leading to clashes and prompting the Spanish prime minister to blame trafficking gangs.
Hamas indicated it would hand over weapons to a new Gaza administration if Israel withdraws, following claims of a disarmament agreement by former US President Trump.

UK petrol prices surged to their highest this year due to renewed US bombing in the Middle East, while ExxonMobil and Chevron reported quadrupled profits from rising oil prices attributed to the Iran war.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite both closed higher, driven by positive news including an excellent quarter for Amazon and a significant rally in South Korea's chip giants, which bolstered confidence in the tech sector.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield increased as Federal Reserve officials who voted for interest rate hikes emphasized the necessity of immediate action to counter inflation, which has remained above the Fed's 2% target for over five years.

vix.why: The VIX decreased, reflecting a reduction in market volatility. This coincided with positive movements in major stock indices and analyst views that recent market selling offered a valuation opportunity in U.S. stocks, suggesting diminished investor fear.

tech.summary: General Motors plans to introduce a proprietary in-vehicle artificial intelligence system later this year, designed specifically for its customers.
Google reported fixing more Chrome bugs in June than over the past two years, attributing this accelerated progress to the integration of AI in its processes.
Apple CEO Tim Cook hinted at a potential iCloud Plus tier for "AI power users," suggesting that the company may offer upgrade possibilities to increase AI usage limits for its services.

world.summary:
Approximately 60,000 migrants arrived in the Spanish enclave of Ceuta from Morocco within 24 hours, leading to border clashes and prompting Spain's Prime Minister Pedro S
chez to attribute the surge to trafficking gangs.

Hamas stated its willingness to hand over weapons to a new Gaza administration, contingent upon an Israeli withdrawal, following claims by former US President Trump of an agreement for Hamas's complete disarmament.
UK petrol prices have risen to their highest level this year after renewed US military actions in Iran, contributing to significant profit surges for major oil companies ExxonMobil and Chevron.
